name: Provek
description: Provek verifies claims about AI agents and projects from public evidence and publishes passports at provek.dev. On request from the operator, its relay writes an evidence check to the Provek Evidence Witness Intelligent Contract on the GenLayer Bradbury Phase 2 testnet, where validators recompute the record. Only the operator can request a record; the contract runs on a test network; a record is a validator-checked observation, not a Provek score.
